rules.text: Each page is identified by exact cursor string. A page whose cursor was already processed is ignored, emits stop, returns accepted=false/done=true, and performs no item mutation.
Within and across pages, identity is exact eventId. The first occurrence fixes stable output position; a later duplicate replaces its stored payload/value without moving that position.
A previously unseen page is processed in input order and emits page first, then one append or replace event per entry/item.
After processing a new page, if nextCursor is null the merge is done. If nextCursor equals any already-processed cursor, emit stop and mark done to prevent a pagination loop.
Once done, later page calls are ignored with accepted=false/done=true and emit stop only. result/timeline preserves first-seen identity order with latest duplicate value.
Trace is append-only and copied on read. Public event order uses only page, append, replace, stop and exactly reflects page processing decisions.

callableSurface.ownership: The merger owns processed-cursor state, stable identity order, latest values, done state and trace. Caller owns immutable page objects.

transitions: unseen page with fresh nextCursor -> collecting
repeated/current page or any page after done -> done/no mutation

eventOrdering: page is emitted before item events for an accepted page
stop is emitted after accepted-page item events when termination is discovered
ignored repeated/post-done page emits stop only
abortErrorPrecedence: There is no error/abort surface. Repeat-cursor and already-done termination checks prevent mutation before any page processing.

identityMutation.inputs: page and contained item/entry objects are read only
identityMutation.identity: exact eventId controls replacement while first-seen order is immutable
identityMutation.trace: trace and result/timeline return copied arrays and copied record objects
